topics.topic: Values Education: Meaning, types of values, and importance to national cohesion
learningObjectives: Define values in a sociological and civic context
Distinguish between moral, spiritual, material, and civic values
Explain how sound national values promote political stability and economic progress

topics.topic: National Consciousness, National Integrity, and Building a Unified Nigeria
learningObjectives: Explain the concept of national consciousness and patriotism
Identify factors that promote national unity (inter-tribal marriage, NYSC, federal character)
Analyze obstacles to national consciousness: ethnicity, religious bigotry, and nepotism

topics.topic: Capitalist Democracy: Features, merits, and challenges in developing democracies
learningObjectives: Define capitalist democracy and identify its core principles (free enterprise, multi-party system)
Highlight advantages: freedom of enterprise, individual initiative, and political choice
Discuss shortcomings of capitalism in emerging economies like income disparity

topics.topic: Rule of Law: Principles, equality before the law, and limits to legal authority
learningObjectives: State A.V. Dicey’s three cardinal principles of the Rule of Law
Explain equality of all citizens before ordinary law courts regardless of rank
Analyze factors that limit the Rule of Law (state of emergency, diplomatic immunity, judicial corruption)

topics.topic: Fundamental Human Rights: Limitations to rights, state of emergency, and public safety
learningObjectives: List fundamental human rights enshrined in Chapter IV of the 1999 Constitution
Explain circumstances under which rights may be legally curtailed (curfew, treason, epidemics)
Evaluate the role of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) in safeguarding citizens

topics.topic: Youth Empowerment: Roles of government and civil society in vocational development
learningObjectives: Define youth empowerment and identify vocational skills for self-reliance
Evaluate government schemes (NDE, SMEDAN, skills acquisition centers)
Discuss the impact of youth empowerment on crime reduction and nation building

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & National Policy Colloquium
learningObjectives: Assess pupil mastery of values education, rule of law, and constitutional human rights
Conduct a classroom debate on "Capitalist Democracy vs Democratic Socialism in Nigeria"
Provide remedial coaching on the limits of constitutional rights

topics.topic: Responsible Parenthood: Roles of parents, child spacing, and eradicating street hawking
learningObjectives: Define responsible parenthood and list parental obligations under the Child Rights Act
Discuss consequences of parental irresponsibility (juvenile delinquency, drug abuse, street trading)
Evaluate community interventions aimed at eradicating out-of-school children

topics.topic: Traffic Regulations: Causes of road crashes, FRSC guidelines, and highway codes
learningObjectives: Identify common causes of vehicular accidents on Nigerian highways (speeding, drunk driving)
Explain statutory responsibilities of the Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) and VIO
Interpret regulatory, warning, and informatory road traffic signs

topics.topic: Public Service in Nigeria: Structure, civil service characteristics, bureaucracy, and reforms
learningObjectives: Define public service and differentiate it from the civil service
List characteristics of the civil service: anonymity, neutrality, permanence, and meritocracy
Identify challenges facing Nigerian public service: red tape, tribalism, and ghost workers

topics.topic: Anti-Corruption Agencies: Mandates of EFCC, ICPC, and Code of Conduct Bureau
learningObjectives: State legislative mandates and establishment history of EFCC and ICPC
Explain functions of the Code of Conduct Bureau and Code of Conduct Tribunal in asset declaration
Discuss citizen whistleblowing roles in exposing public financial misappropriation

topics.topic: Comprehensive Civic Education Revision & Mock WAEC Clinic
learningObjectives: Review key competencies across governance, rule of law, youth empowerment, and integrity
Practice past WASSCE Paper 1 and Paper 2 essay question construction
Reinforce precise civic terminology and structured essay arguments
Evaluate cumulative SSS 1 Civic Education comprehension through standardized papers
Score essay scripts using official WAEC marking guidelines
Enter verified student grades into school academic broadsheets
